about.title: You talk to the person who designs and builds
about.text: For over 10 years I have been creating B2B software: data platforms, ERP and MES systems, and tools for teams' daily work. I talk to the people, design and take it to a working version myself, so nothing gets lost between teams.

credentials.label: ERP and MES for the paper industry

items.q: Who owns the code and data?
items.a: Once the project is paid for, the code and data belong to your company. We put that in the contract.

items.q: What if you stop working on it?
items.a: I hand over the code with setup instructions so another developer can take it over.

items.q: Where will the data be stored?
items.a: We agree on that before the start, along with who has access and how backups work.
Yes, for design and building, because it lets me work faster. I am responsible for how it works and for its quality. Client data goes into such tools only if we agree on it first.

items.q: Do you write the code yourself?
items.a: I started as a frontend developer, but I no longer spend my days in code. I build with AI tools, and my experience lets me judge what comes out of them. I am responsible for the result. If a project needs an additional developer, I say so right away.

items.q: Can you join an existing product and team?
items.a: Yes. I start by learning the product, the team and the users, then work with your team or on my own, depending on what you need.
We set the deadline once I understand the problem, because before that it would be an empty promise. We put it in writing with the scope and price.
We agree on scope, deadline and price in writing before the start. 50% is due at the start, the rest on acceptance.

items.q: How much of my team's time will it take?
items.a: A few conversations at the start with the people who work with the product. After that, short reviews of what has been made.
Yes, if the project needs one. We can do that before we discuss details.

items.q: Do you work with companies outside Poland?
items.a: Yes. I work remotely, in Polish and in English.
